verses.original: χάριν Τούτου ἐγὼ Παῦλος ὁ δέσμιος τοῦ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν τῶν ἐθνῶν
verses.transliteration: charin Toutou egō Paulos ho desmios tou Christou Iēsou hyper hymōn tōn ethnōn
verses.literal: For this reason . . . I Paul the prisoner - of Christ Jesus for the sake of you - Gentiles

verses.original: Εἴ γε ἠκούσατε τὴν οἰκονομίαν τοῦ Θεοῦ τῆς χάριτος τῆς δοθείσης μοι εἰς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Ei ge ēkousate tēn oikonomian tou Theou tēs charitos tēs dotheisēs moi eis hymas
verses.literal: vvv Surely you have heard about the stewardship - of God’s - grace - that was given to me for you

verses.original: ὅτι τὸ μυστήριον ἐγνωρίσθη μοι κατὰ ἀποκάλυψιν καθὼς προέγραψα ἐν ὀλίγῳ
verses.transliteration: hoti to mystērion egnōristhē moi kata apokalypsin kathōs proegrapsa en oligō
verses.literal: that [is] the mystery made known to me by revelation as I have already written vvv briefly

verses.original: πρὸς ἀναγινώσκοντες ὃ δύνασθε νοῆσαι μου τὴν σύνεσίν ἐν τῷ μυστηρίῳ τοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: pros anaginōskontes ho dynasthe noēsai mou tēn synesin en tō mystēriō tou Christou
verses.literal: In reading this, then you will be able to understand my - insight into the mystery - of Christ

verses.original: ὃ οὐκ ἐγνωρίσθη τοῖς υἱοῖς τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἑτέραις γενεαῖς ὡς νῦν ἀπεκαλύφθη ἐν Πνεύματι τοῖς αὐτοῦ ἁγίοις ἀποστόλοις καὶ προφήταις
verses.transliteration: ho ouk egnōristhē tois huiois tōn anthrōpōn heterais geneais hōs nyn apekalyphthē en Pneumati tois autou hagiois apostolois kai prophētais
verses.literal: which vvv was not made known vvv vvv vvv to men in other generations as vvv it has now been revealed by [the] Spirit to [God’s] holy apostles and prophets

verses.original: διὰ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου τὰ ἔθνη εἶναι συνκληρονόμα καὶ σύσσωμα καὶ συμμέτοχα τῆς ἐπαγγελίας ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: dia tou euangeliou ta ethnē einai synklēronoma kai syssōma kai symmetocha tēs epangelias en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: [This mystery is that] through the gospel the Gentiles are fellow heirs - fellow members of the body and fellow partakers of the promise in Christ Jesus

verses.original: ἐγενήθην διάκονος οὗ κατὰ τὴν δωρεὰν τοῦ Θεοῦ τῆς χάριτος τῆς δοθείσης μοι κατὰ τὴν ἐνέργειαν τῆς αὐτοῦ δυνάμεως
verses.transliteration: egenēthēn diakonos hou kata tēn dōrean tou Theou tēs charitos tēs dotheisēs moi kata tēn energeian tēs autou dynameōs
verses.literal: I became a servant of [this gospel] by the gift - of God’s - grace - given me through the working of His power

verses.original: τῷ ἐλαχιστοτέρῳ πάντων ἁγίων αὕτη ἡ χάρις ἐδόθη Ἐμοὶ εὐαγγελίσασθαι τοῖς ἔθνεσιν τὸ ἀνεξιχνίαστον πλοῦτος τοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: tō elachistoterō pantōn hagiōn hautē hē charis edothē Emoi euangelisasthai tois ethnesin to anexichniaston ploutos tou Christou
verses.literal: [Though I am] less than the least of all [the] saints this - grace was given me to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches - of Christ

verses.original: καὶ φωτίσαι πάντας τίς ἡ οἰκονομία τοῦ μυστηρίου τοῦ ἀπὸ τῶν αἰώνων ἀποκεκρυμμένου ἐν τῷ Θεῷ τῷ κτίσαντι τὰ πάντα
verses.transliteration: kai phōtisai pantas tis hē oikonomia tou mystēriou tou apo tōn aiōnōn apokekrymmenou en tō Theō tō ktisanti ta panta
verses.literal: and to illuminate for everyone - the stewardship of [this] mystery which for - ages past was kept hidden in - God who created - all things

verses.original: ἵνα νῦν διὰ τῆς ἐκκλησίας ἡ πολυποίκιλος σοφία τοῦ Θεοῦ γνωρισθῇ ταῖς ἀρχαῖς καὶ ταῖς ἐξουσίαις ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις
verses.transliteration: hina nyn dia tēs ekklēsias hē polypoikilos sophia tou Theou gnōristhē tais archais kai tais exousiais en tois epouraniois
verses.literal: [ His purpose was ] that now through the church the manifold wisdom - of God should be made known to the rulers and - authorities in the heavenly realms

verses.original: κατὰ τῶν αἰώνων πρόθεσιν ἣν ἐποίησεν ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ἡμῶν τῷ Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: kata tōn aiōnōn prothesin hēn epoiēsen en tō Christō Iēsou hēmōn tō Kyriō
verses.literal: according to vvv [the] eternal purpose that He accomplished in - Christ Jesus our - Lord

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ διὰ τῆς πίστεως αὐτοῦ ἔχομεν προσαγωγὴν τὴν παρρησίαν καὶ ἐν πεποιθήσει
verses.transliteration: en hō dia tēs pisteōs autou echomen prosagōgēn tēn parrēsian kai en pepoithēsei
verses.literal: In Him [and] through - faith in Him we may enter [ God’s ] presence - with boldness and . . . confidence

verses.original: Διὸ αἰτοῦμαι μὴ ἐνκακεῖν ἐν μου ταῖς θλίψεσίν ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν ἥτις ἐστὶν ὑμῶν δόξα
verses.transliteration: Dio aitoumai mē enkakein en mou tais thlipsesin hyper hymōn hētis estin hymōn doxa
verses.literal: So I ask [you] not to be discouraged because of my - sufferings for you which are your glory

verses.original: χάριν Τούτου κάμπτω μου τὰ γόνατά πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα
verses.transliteration: charin Toutou kamptō mou ta gonata pros ton Patera
verses.literal: ... for this reason . . . I bow my - knees before the Father

verses.original: ἐξ οὗ πᾶσα πατριὰ ἐν οὐρανοῖς καὶ ἐπὶ γῆς ὀνομάζεται
verses.transliteration: ex hou pasa patria en ouranois kai epi gēs onomazetai
verses.literal: from whom every family in heaven and on earth derives its name

verses.original: ἵνα κατὰ τὸ πλοῦτος τῆς αὐτοῦ δόξης δῷ κραταιωθῆναι ὑμῖν δυνάμει διὰ αὐτοῦ τοῦ Πνεύματος εἰς τὸν ἔσω ἄνθρωπον
verses.transliteration: hina kata to ploutos tēs autou doxēs dō krataiōthēnai hymin dynamei dia autou tou Pneumatos eis ton esō anthrōpon
verses.literal: [I ask] that out of the riches of His glory He may strengthen you with power through His - Spirit in [your] inner being

verses.original: τὸν Χριστὸν κατοικῆσαι ἐν ὑμῶν ταῖς καρδίαις διὰ τῆς πίστεως ἐρριζωμένοι καὶ τεθεμελιωμένοι ἐν ἀγάπῃ
verses.transliteration: ton Christon katoikēsai en hymōn tais kardiais dia tēs pisteōs errizōmenoi kai tethemeliōmenoi en agapē
verses.literal: so that Christ may dwell in your - hearts through - faith [Then] you, being rooted and grounded in love

verses.original: ἵνα ἐξισχύσητε σὺν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἁγίοις καταλαβέσθαι τί τὸ μῆκος καὶ πλάτος καὶ ὕψος καὶ βάθος
verses.transliteration: hina exischysēte syn pasin tois hagiois katalabesthai ti to mēkos kai platos kai hypsos kai bathos
verses.literal: - will have power together with all the saints to comprehend - the length and width and height and depth

verses.original: ἀγάπην τοῦ Χριστοῦ τε γνῶναί τὴν ὑπερβάλλουσαν τῆς γνώσεως ἵνα πληρωθῆτε εἰς πᾶν τὸ πλήρωμα τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: agapēn tou Christou te gnōnai tēn hyperballousan tēs gnōseōs hina plērōthēte eis pan to plērōma tou Theou
verses.literal: of the love - of Christ and to know [this love that] surpasses - knowledge that you may be filled with all the fullness - of God

verses.original: δὲ Τῷ δυναμένῳ ποιῆσαι ὑπὲρ ὑπερεκπερισσοῦ πάντα ὧν αἰτούμεθα ἢ νοοῦμεν κατὰ τὴν δύναμιν τὴν ἐνεργουμένην ἐν ἡμῖν
verses.transliteration: de Tō dynamenō poiēsai hyper hyperekperissou panta hōn aitoumetha ē nooumen kata tēn dynamin tēn energoumenēn en hēmin
verses.literal: Now to [Him] who is able to do immeasurably more than all - we ask or imagine according to [His] power that [is] at work within us

verses.original: αὐτῷ ἡ δόξα ἐν τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ καὶ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ εἰς πάσας τὰς γενεὰς τοῦ αἰῶνος τῶν αἰώνων ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: autō hē doxa en tē ekklēsia kai en Christō Iēsou eis pasas tas geneas tou aiōnos tōn aiōnōn amēn
verses.literal: to Him [be] the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus throughout all - generations forever . . . [and] ever Amen
